name: r032.camp_payment_return_v001_mcw
description: Fresh natural bandit Pay and return-ecology route using the accepted R032 Locker camp save plus an isolated reachable CAMP_STORAGE spillover payment stock. Setup provides ten RobofacCoin on a real map tile in CAMP_STORAGE; it does not create a bandit lead, dispatch, operation, contact, or cooldown change. All payment, departure, replenishment opportunity, and renewed contact evidence must come from ordinary native play.

steps.label: operate_natural_camp_payment_and_return_ecology
steps.objective: Start from the exact saved R032 Locker world. Natively confirm camp [162,36,0], assigned CAMP_RESIDENT character:25, original CAMP_STORAGE zone and the setup-only ten RobofacCoin items at the additional follower-owned CAMP_STORAGE tile. Record their actual native inventory/trade identities and current game time. Do not alter actor, camp, lead, outing, operation, or cooldown state. Advance only ordinary native time with alarms until an actually scheduler-created bandit outing produces a peaceful local Pay/Fight demand. Bind the exact site, activity, members, demand and game time. Choose Pay from that live demand; in the native trade UI offer only enough of the zone-tile coins at the displayed trade value, confirm only a complete trade, and prove the same-run item delta, paid result, returning_home commit and physical departure. After departure, disclose and replenish distinct useful stock in CAMP_STORAGE, record its identities/value/time, then continue ordinary native time and alarms through actual scheduler opportunity, map exit/return and renewed contact. Capture useful native save/reload continuity. If contact or return does not occur, retain elapsed time and exact lead, supply, cooldown, risk, route, roster or decision eligibility cause; absence without a genuine opportunity remains unproved.
proof_targets: same native saved R032 Assignment Camp [162,36,0], character:25/CAMP_RESIDENT and accepted Locker source footing
native observation of both the existing CAMP_STORAGE tile and added spillover zone/RobofacCoin stock at the exact map tile
actual native Pay/Fight prompt from a scheduler-owned bandit outing with site, activity and member identity
same-run trade API, demanded/reachable/pool values, map-location RobofacCoin selector entry, accepted trade, and exact item/charge deltas
same-operation paid returning_home transition, physical NPC travel order/departure and useful save/reload continuity
disclosed distinct replenishment after departure with game time and item/value identity
ordinary-time lead update, scheduler eligibility/opportunity, map exit/return and renewed native contact; or an exact causal non-return boundary after a real opportunity
game time at payment/departure, replenishment and first returned contact, plus source/camp/member identity and resources/casualties
invariants: fixture zone and coin stock are setup only and earn zero gameplay credit
no injected bandit lead, dispatch, outing, operation, contact, or shortened cooldown
no direct state/save/actor/item mutation after fixture installation
demand and trade valuation are read only from the actual native run
no prior R-029 payment or continuation evidence is reused as fresh camp-stock proof
use the peaceful-branch save only after coordinator identifies its exact saved state; do not touch a defense-owned process or scenario
preserve first missing scheduler premise and elapsed time; no invented return deadline

steps.label: verify_camp_payment_and_ecology_after_reload
steps.objective: Independently re-observe the same camp, paid operation identity/phase, coin and replenishment deltas, returning party/roster state and current scheduler/lead eligibility after a native save and process replacement. Continue only ordinary time with alarms until a natural eligible outing exits and returns into renewed contact, or preserve the exact opportunity and blocking cause. Do not restage fixture items or alter scheduler state.
proof_targets: new game process generation and same saved world/camp/actor identity
persisted paid state, exact stock delta and any returning-home bandit identities
ordinary-time scheduler and lead evidence through renewed contact or causally explained non-return after opportunity
native cleanup of the owned run and bridge
invariants: no fixture reinstallation or state rewrite during continuation
no injected dispatch or shortened cooldown
process replacement and fresh native observations are required
